_README: Block and creation transaction of the ADEXTO v1 factory (AdextoFactory 1.0.0) on each mainnet.
Checked against the chain on 2026-10-01: each transaction is from the deployer below, and its receipt has contractAddress = factory.
Used by the Verify it yourself checklist on /security.
rpc: the endpoint checked to answer every command in that checklist, including `cast receipt` for old transactions.
sourceCommit: the commit the factory was compiled from (solc 0.8.37, EVM cancun, 200 runs, via-IR).
Recompiled from that commit, the runtime equals the on-chain code on every chain below except two 20-byte slots, which hold protocolTreasury (immutable).
With those slots zeroed, keccak(chain code) = keccak(artifact runtime) = maskedKeccak. Sourcify reports an exact match on every chain.

Arc (5042) was broadcast on 2026-10-06 from commit 3b23f56 (its own sourceCommit). The factory sources there are identical to 71b5adf: `git diff 71b5adf 3b23f56 -- contracts/` only adds AdextoStakeHub.sol. Its runtime keccak equals the other chains'.
